hooks.name: Backend tests on save
hooks.description: Run the backend test suite (embedded Postgres, ~50 s) after a backend Python file is saved.

hooks.name: Retrieval eval on retrieval changes
hooks.description: Retrieval, embeddings, topicality, floors or migrations changed: re-run the hashing retrieval eval (off-topic false positives must stay 0.00).

hooks.name: Frontend typecheck on save
hooks.description: Typecheck the Next.js app after a frontend source file is saved.
